cards.title: Gana nuevos clientes
cards.line: Tus publicaciones, anuncios y formularios atraen a compradores y a propietarios que quieren vender. Cada comentario o mensaje directo se convierte en una consulta con su ficha.
cards.phone: De un comentario a una consulta.
examples: Formulario de tu anuncio «¿Cuánto vale tu casa?»: Isabel, casa en Mijas

Ficha nueva: propietaria · Mijas · quiere vender · pide valoración

cards.title: Reactiva tus contactos
cards.line: Cuando entra un inmueble que encaja o hay un motivo nuevo, volvemos a escribir a tus antiguos interesados y clientes, con su permiso.
cards.phone: Tus contactos de siempre, otra vez activos.
examples: Javier escribió en marzo: ático en Benalmádena, hasta 280.000 €
Hoy entra un ático en Benalmádena, 275.000 €
Le escribimos, con su permiso: «¿Sigues buscando?» · Javier: «Sí, ¿cuándo puedo verlo?»

cards.title: Del interés a la oportunidad
cards.line: Responde, aclara qué busca cada cliente, le propone inmuebles que encajan y, con su permiso, hace seguimiento.
cards.phone: Cada interesado, con su siguiente paso.
examples: Laura pregunta por un piso en Estepona · respuesta al momento y una pregunta
Le proponemos 2 pisos que encajan: 2 dormitorios, hasta 320.000 €
No contesta en dos días · seguimiento con su permiso · pide visita

cards.title: Atiende el teléfono por ti
cards.line: Cuando estás en una visita, el asistente coge la llamada, anota qué busca y te deja la tarea.
cards.phone: Ninguna llamada perdida en una visita.
examples: 11:39 · Álvaro llama · estás en una visita
Atendida · la villa de Elviria, precio y margen
Tarea: devolver la llamada a partir de las 16:00

cards.title: Cada mañana, el día claro
cards.line: Cada mañana, cada persona del equipo sabe qué tiene que hacer hoy y con quién.
cards.phone: Tu día, ordenado a las 8:30.
examples: 08:30 · Buenos días, Marta. Hoy, 3 cosas:
Proponer fecha a los Keller · Devolver la llamada a Álvaro, desde las 16:00
Enviar a Sofía lo disponible en alquiler

cards.title: Tu semana, en un informe
cards.line: Cada lunes ves qué entró, qué sigue abierto y qué hacer esta semana.
cards.phone: Qué entró y qué hacer.
examples: Lunes 08:00 · 25 consultas, 25 respondidas

Esta semana: proponer fecha a las 2 visitas pendientes

en-target-390.eyebrow: Everything it does for your agency
en-target-390.h2: New clients. Contacts who come back. More opportunities for your agency.
en-target-390.afterGrowth: Every morning, which opportunities need your attention.

cards.chip: From Growth · social media on Enterprise
cards.title: Win new clients
cards.line: Your posts, ads and lead forms draw in buyers and owners who want to sell. Every comment or direct message becomes an enquiry with its own record.
cards.phone: From a comment to an enquiry.
examples: The form on your ad "What is your home worth?": Isabel, house in Mijas
An instant reply and one question: "Roughly how many square metres is it?"
New record: owner · Mijas · wants to sell · asks for a valuation

cards.title: Bring contacts back
cards.line: When a listing that fits comes in, or there is a new reason to get in touch, we write again to your past enquirers and clients, with their permission.
cards.phone: Your past contacts, active again.
examples: Javier wrote in March: penthouse in Benalmádena, up to €280,000
Today a penthouse in Benalmádena comes in, €275,000
We write to him, with his permission: "Still looking?" · Javier: "Yes, when can I see it?"

cards.title: From interest to opportunity
cards.line: It replies, finds out what each client is looking for, suggests listings that fit and, with their permission, follows up.
cards.phone: Every lead, with its next step.
examples: Laura asks about a flat in Estepona · an instant reply and one question
We suggest 2 flats that fit: 2 bedrooms, up to €320,000
No reply in two days · a follow-up with her permission · she asks for a viewing

cards.title: Answers the phone for you
cards.line: When you're at a viewing, the assistant takes the call, notes what they want and leaves you the task.
cards.phone: No call missed during a viewing.
examples: 11:39 · Álvaro calls · you're at a viewing
Answered · the villa in Elviria, price and room to negotiate
Task: call back from 16:00

cards.title: Every morning, a clear day
cards.line: Every morning, everyone on the team knows what to do today and with whom.
cards.phone: Your day, sorted by 8:30.
examples: 08:30 · Good morning, Marta. Today, 3 things:
Propose a date to the Kellers · Call Álvaro back, from 16:00
Send Sofía what's available to rent

cards.title: Your week, in one report
cards.line: Every Monday you see what came in, what is still open and what to do this week.
cards.phone: What came in and what to do.
examples: Monday 08:00 · 25 enquiries, 25 answered
9 with the office closed · 4 viewings agreed
This week: propose a date for the 2 open viewings

cards.title: Your floor plan, in 3D
cards.line: We turn your floor plan into a 3D model, empty and furnished, with images for your listings.
cards.phone: From floor plan to listing images.
examples: Plan: plano-estepona.pdf
Model, empty and furnished
Images for listings and social media · marked as a visualisation

en-target-390.dayLine: While you show a home, NuovaSolution answers.
en-target-390.compact: 08:30 your day · 11:39 call answered · 13:20 passed to Carlos · 16:00 a listing that fits · 18:00 follow-up · 23:40 a night-time reply

stations.text: Marta opens her summary: she knows what's on today and with whom.
Marta is at a viewing; the assistant takes Álvaro's call and leaves her the task.
Nobody has taken Laura's viewing: it passes to Carlos, and he takes it.
A new flat comes in in Estepona: it fits Laura, and its social media post waits for your OK.
Sofía hasn't replied: she gets a follow-up, with her permission.
An enquiry arrives with the office closed: an instant reply, and tomorrow at 8:30 it's in your summary.

en-target-390.heroSub: NuovaSolution brings in clients, answers enquiries and follows up. It re-engages past contacts, suggests properties and shows you what deserves your attention, so your business moves forward without everything depending on you.
